newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RESEARCH ALERT - Metrobank rated a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Metrobank rated a sell.

text.p: Urbancorp Securities Inc recommended a trading sell on Metropolitan Bank and Trust Co (Metrobank) on Friday after its shares reached an all-time high of 720 pesos.
"Technical formation shows that its share price is overbought, and is now due for correction in the short-term," Urbancorp said in a report.
Nevertheless, Urbancorp said the bank's bottom line would continue to grow in the coming years due to its vast financial resources, extensive branch network and sound management.
The bank share closed at its record high of 720 pesos on Friday, up 20 pesos from 700 pesos.
